name: Kit 7 — GBP Network Builder (Hub-and-Spoke Multi-Profile System)

nodes.name: GBP Builder Webhook
nodes.notes: Receives: business_name, industry, owner_whatsapp, tier1_suburbs[], tier2_suburbs[]

nodes.name: Split Tier 1 Suburbs
nodes.notes: Processes each Tier 1 suburb individually to build its GBP profile content

values.content:
=You are a Google Business Profile expert and local SEO copywriter for Australian businesses.

Create a complete GBP profile for this suburb location:

Business: {{ $('GBP Builder Webhook').item.json.business_name }}
Industry: {{ $('GBP Builder Webhook').item.json.industry }}
Suburb: {{ $json.name }}
Suburb Notes: {{ $json.notes }}
Key Landmarks: {{ $json.landmarks }}

Generate ALL of the following as a single JSON object:

1. business_description (750 chars max): Unique description for this suburb profile. Mention the suburb name naturally, reference local context. NOT generic — this must feel written for Bondi (or whatever suburb), not copy-pasted.

2. short_description (250 chars): For the GBP 'from the business' section.

3. gbp_categories: Array of up to 5 relevant GBP categories for this industry.

4. services_list: Array of 10 specific services with short descriptions (50 chars each).

5. qa_pairs: Array of 15 Q&A pairs. Mix of:
   - Generic industry FAQs (how much does X cost, how quickly, are you licensed)
   - Suburb-specific questions (do you service [suburb], what areas do you cover near [suburb])
   - Comparison questions (why choose you over [generic competitor type])
   Format: [{"q": "...", "a": "..."}]

6. first_post: A GBP post (300 words max) about serving [suburb] — introduce the business, local context, call to action.

7. photo_geo_tags: 5 location tags to embed in EXIF of uploaded photos (suburb street names/landmarks to use as GPS coordinates anchors).

8. service_area_keywords: 20 keywords to use in the service area description for maximum local relevance.

Return ONLY valid JSON.

nodes.name: Claude — Generate Suburb GBP Content
nodes.notes: Generates fully unique, suburb-specific GBP content for each Tier 1 location

nodes.name: Create GBP Listing via API
nodes.notes: Creates the GBP service area listing via Google My Business API. Requires OAuth2 with mybusiness.business.manage scope.

nodes.name: Publish First GBP Post
nodes.notes: Publishes the first suburb-specific post to the newly created GBP profile

nodes.name: Seed First Q&A Question
nodes.notes: Seeds Q&A section. The full 15 Q&As are iterated via a sub-loop (see qa-seeder sub-workflow). This node seeds the first one as a trigger.

nodes.name: Log GBP Profile to Sheet
nodes.notes: Tracks all created GBP profiles with their IDs for the weekly posting and rank scanning workflows

meta.description: Builds a hub-and-spoke network of GBP service area listings across every Tier 1 suburb. Each profile gets unique Claude-written descriptions, Q&As, and a published first post. All profiles are logged to Google Sheets for the weekly auto-posting and grid rank scanning workflows.
